scope: capability boundary: the offline resource set ships only the mp_cross_fire fastfiles
conclusion: the client can only load maps whose fastfiles exist in this resource set, and only mp_cross_fire does
that is why --gamestate-map mp_afghan disconnects early even though the map name now reaches the client correctly
the same 2.6.9.7 launcher ships afghan fastfiles, but they belong to a different build (2.6.9.7) and cannot be mixed with a 3.19 client
so multi-map support is a RESOURCE limitation, not a server limitation - the server-side override is fixed and ready
